decisions.decision: Mr. Terry did not need a formal vote; the Board gave a majority consensus on the firefighter negotiating position, with no vote taken.
decisions.quote: mr. terry stated he did not need a vote tonight only consensus of the board at this point. there was a majority consensus.

decisions.decision: Mr. Terry and Ms. Speidel will follow up after Mr. Terry discusses the proposal with the firefighter representative.
decisions.quote: mr. terry and ms. speidel will touch base after he discusses with the firefighter representative.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The firefighters asked for a detail rate increase, which would take the rate to $42.00 per hour and add a small increase for town departments.
budget_items.quote: the detail rate would go up to $42.00 per hour. they did ask for a small increase on town departments of $2.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Increase in cost to the town from raising call-back pay from two to three hours, estimated at $6,000 to $7,000 per year if all calls are counted, with a realistic figure of $3,000 to $4,000.
budget_items.quote: the increase in costs for the town would be around $6,000 to $7,000 more per year if you counted all calls. a realistic number would be around $3,000 to $4,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of moving the town to 24/7 EMS coverage, estimated to cost $200,000 to $220,000; it would severely reduce on-call events and covers only full-time bargaining unit personnel.
budget_items.quote: the cost of this was estimated to be $200,000 to $220,000.
